# Learned instinct: change-blast-radius-required (confidence 0.97)

Before authoring or proposing any change to PCI-scope systems, the blast radius must be documented: which systems are affected, what is the expected behavior change, what is the rollback plan, and what is the test evidence. The gateguard-fact-force hook enforces this at the tool boundary. Changes without documented blast radius will be blocked.

Source: PCI DSS v4.0.1 Req 6.5; infra-ops CLAUDE.md hard rule #1
